sloka: प्रभग्ना चिर रात्री इयम् मम सीताम् अपश्यतः ।तापसो वा भविष्यामि नियतो वृक्ष मूलिकः ॥५-१३-४५॥
transliteration: prabhagnā cira rātrī iyam mama sītām apaśyataḥ ।tāpaso vā bhaviṣyāmi niyato vṛkṣa mūlikaḥ ॥5-13-45॥

translations.english: "I will remain an ascetic and do penance under the tree practising selfcontrol and not go back without seeing the blackeyed Sita.
